SamuroWayOfIllusion.name: Way of Illusion
SamuroWayOfIllusion.description: Quest: Every time a Mirror Image Critically Strikes a Hero, Samuro gains 0.25 Attack Damage, up to 10. Reward: After hitting 40 Heroes, Samuro gains an additional 30 Attack Damage.

SamuroMirrorImageWayOfTheBlade.name: Way of the Blade
SamuroMirrorImageWayOfTheBlade.description: Critical Strike now happens for Samuro and his Mirror Images every 3rd Basic Attack. Samuro and his Mirror Images' Critical Strikes against enemy Heroes reduce their Physical Armor by 5 for 2.25 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

SamuroWayOfTheWind.name: Way of the Wind
SamuroWayOfTheWind.description: Gain 40% Movement Speed for 3 seconds after entering or exiting Wind Walk. Casting Wind Walk heals Samuro for 4% of his maximum Health.

SamuroMirage.name: Mirage
SamuroMirage.description: Mirror Image grants Samuro and his Images 40 Spell Armor against the next 2 sources of Spell Damage, reducing their damage by 40%.

SamuroWindwalkOneWithTheWind.name: One With The Wind
SamuroWindwalkOneWithTheWind.description: While Samuro has Wind Walk active and for 3 seconds after breaking it, both he and his Mirror Images gain 30 Armor, taking 30% reduced damage from all sources.

SamuroAdvancingStrikesDeflection.name: Deflection
SamuroAdvancingStrikesDeflection.description: Advancing Strikes grants Samuro and his Mirror Images 35 Physical Armor.

SamuroBurningBlade.name: Burning Blade
SamuroBurningBlade.description: Critical Strikes from Samuro and Mirror Images deal an additional 50% of their Basic Attack damage as Spell Damage to the target and nearby enemies.

SamuroPhantomPain.name: Phantom Pain
SamuroPhantomPain.description: Samuro's Critical Strikes against enemy Heroes deal an additional 35% of his Basic Attack damage for each Mirror Image that is active and reduce the cooldown of Image Transmission by 1 second.

SamuroCrushingBlow.name: Crushing Blows
SamuroCrushingBlow.description: Samuro's Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Critical Strike by 2 seconds. Critical Strikes against enemy Heroes increase Samuro's Basic Attack damage by 10% for 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

SamuroHeroicAbilityBladestorm.name: Bladestorm
SamuroHeroicAbilityBladestorm.description: Cause a Bladestorm of destructive force around Samuro for 3 seconds, granting him 25 Armor and dealing 180 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.

SamuroHeroicAbilityIllusionMaster.name: Illusion Master
SamuroHeroicAbilityIllusionMaster.description: Mirror Images can be controlled individually or as a group and their damage is increased by 100%. Passive: Image Transmission's cooldown is reduced to 8 seconds.

SamuroMirroredSteel.name: Mirrored Steel
SamuroMirroredSteel.description: Samuro's Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Mirror Image by 0.75 seconds.

SamuroWindwalkKawarimi.name: Kawarimi
SamuroWindwalkKawarimi.description: Wind Walk creates a Mirror Image at Samuro's location that will continue whatever he was doing.

SamuroShukuchi.name: Shukuchi
SamuroShukuchi.description: Wind Walk teleports Samuro a short distance in the direction he's currently facing.

SamuroMercilessStrikes.name: Merciless Strikes
SamuroMercilessStrikes.description: Samuro's Basic Attacks against Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed enemies are always Critical Strikes.

SamuroHarshWinds.name: Harsh Winds
SamuroHarshWinds.description: Attacking a Hero during Wind Walk causes them to take 30% increased damage from Samuro for 3 seconds.

SamuroPressTheAttack.name: Press the Attack
SamuroPressTheAttack.description: While Advancing Strikes is active, Samuro and his Mirror Images gain 10% Attack Speed every time they Basic Attack, up to 40%.

SamuroDanceOfDeath.name: Dance Of Death
SamuroDanceOfDeath.description: Mirror Images use Bladestorm when Samuro does, but for 45% damage. If Samuro hits at least 20 enemy Heroes with Bladestorm, then reset its cooldown.

SamuroThreeBladeStyle.name: Three Blade Style
SamuroThreeBladeStyle.description: Samuro's Mirror Images only deal half of the damage they take to themselves, effectively increasing their Health by 25% and their duration is increased to 16 seconds.

SamuroWindStrider.name: Wind Strider
SamuroWindStrider.description: Wind Walk's cooldown is reduced by 6 seconds.

SamuroBlademastersPursuit.name: Blademaster's Pursuit
SamuroBlademastersPursuit.description: Advancing Strikes grants an additional 15% Movement Speed for Samuro and his Mirror Images, and its duration is increased by 2 seconds.
